summary: The bounded Writer workbench meets its approved single-paragraph accessible editing contract while explicitly preserving the wider parity gap.
findings: No confirmed defects: controlled text editing, immutable Writer model integration, lifecycle feedback, Writer-only visibility, tests, and documentation are present.
residual_risks: Rich text, multi-paragraph editing, selections, undo/redo UI, persistence, formats, layout, and atomic upstream parity mappings remain separate tasks.
